title: Heliobond investment_vault — queued withdrawals double-counted in NAV; no live deployment
closed_reasons: no Stellar mainnet/testnet Heliobond contract could be identified (repo, frontend, backend, CI, npm, stellar.expert index, Soroban RPC)
the double-count bug was fixed on main by e99b4cc (PR #647) on 2026-09-26 17:31 UTC, the same day it was triaged
the production frontend is demo-mode with no configured backend and no contract IDs in its bundles; heliobond.io is NXDOMAIN
GitHub Actions has never deployed: deploy.yml 33/33 failed, network-tests deploy job skipped in all 192 runs
key_facts: vulnerable code: read_total_assets() = liquid + investments + expected, without subtracting QueuedClaim liabilities (c79daec1, queue feature 5d0a576 on 2026-06-26)
fix: total_assets() subtracts VaultKey::QueuedLiabilities (e99b4cc, merged 2026-09-26 17:31 UTC, still on main b233e10)

attacker model: existing shareholder redeems at the inflated NAV after a majority holder's redemption queues; diversion = min(TA*s_a/S_r, liquid) - s_a*(TA-Q)/S_r, approaching the queued claim for a small holder
deterministic PoC (40k victim + 10k attacker + 15k funded, 7-dec USDC): attacker nets 25,000 USDC, queued claimant shortfall 25,040 USDC, total_assets 15,000 < queued 40,040
ERC-4626 donation/inflation path infeasible (~$9.95e11 donation needed to zero a 1,000 USDC deposit)
latent TTL/archival risk on QueuedLiabilities (no explicit extend_ttl) for dormant queues
caveats: negative deployment conclusion depends on stellar.expert index completeness and WASM marker/hash matching; a modified-source deployment without identifying strings cannot be excluded absolutely
latent risk only materialises if someone deploys a pre-fix build with funds; current main is fixed
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: no Heliobond contract exists on Stellar mainnet and the queued-withdrawal double-count was fixed on main the same day it was reported; latent risk is up to ~the outstanding queue if a pre-fix build is ever deployed with funds.
